results.evidence: Both frontend/src/products.tsx (`'/ml-inference/playground': ['DecisionPlayground', 'decisionPlayground'],`) and products/ml_inference/manifest.tsx (`'/ml-inference/playground': ['DecisionPlayground', 'decisionPlayground'],`) now register a route at the new address pointing to the same DecisionPlayground scene/decisionPlayground url key that previously lived at '/ml-inference/decisions'.

The old routes entry '/ml-inference/decisions': ['DecisionPlayground', 'decisionPlayground'] was removed from both productRoutes in frontend/src/products.tsx and manifest.routes in products/ml_inference/manifest.tsx; it no longer appears as a routes key in either file, only as a redirect target key.

productUrls.decisionPlayground and manifest.urls.decisionPlayground were both updated to return '/ml-inference/playground' (`decisionPlayground: (): string => '/ml-inference/playground',`), so any code calling that url builder function will automatically point to the new address. However, the diff only touches frontend/src/products.tsx and products/ml_inference/manifest.tsx; no menu/sidebar/navigation files are shown, so it can't be confirmed from the given context whether any other file hardcodes the literal string '/ml-inference/decisions' instead of calling urls.decisionPlayground().

products/ml_inference/manifest.tsx still points the DecisionPlayground scene at the same import (`import: () => import('./frontend/DecisionPlaygroundScene')`) with unchanged name/description/layout; only the routes/redirects/urls keys change to the new path, so the scene component and its behavior are untouched.

A redirect was added in both files: frontend/src/products.tsx productRedirects now has `'/ml-inference/decisions': '/ml-inference/playground',` and manifest.tsx has `redirects: { '/ml-inference/decisions': '/ml-inference/playground', }`, using the same redirect mechanism already used for other paths (e.g. '/mcp-analytics'), so visiting the old address redirects to the new one instead of 404ing.

result:
The decisions playground is now served at `/ml-inference/playground`, matching the AI observability playground address. The scene, its content, and the decide API are unchanged.

`products/ml_inference/manifest.tsx` is the source of the app route. Its route and `decisionPlayground` URL builder now return `/ml-inference/playground`, so menu entries and in-app links that call `urls.decisionPlayground()` open the same DecisionPlayground scene at the new address. The old `/ml-inference/decisions` path is a redirect to that address, which is how this repo keeps a shipped app URL working after a rename.

`frontend/src/products.tsx` is the generated route table the app actually mounts (`productRoutes`, `productRedirects`, and `productUrls`). Those three entries were updated to match the manifest.
